description_en: Queries the geographic distribution of users for a domain name. The data is collected at an interval of one day. You can query the data in the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRegionData获取加速域名天粒度的用户区域分布数据统计，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDomainRegionData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries the geographic distribution of users for all accelerated domain names
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range for which the data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range for which the data was queried

RegionProportionData.description_en: The proportions of requests initiated from each region
RegionProportionData.description_zh: 各地域访问占比数据列表

AvgObjectSize.description_en: The average response size. Unit: bytes

AvgResponseRate.description_en: The average response speed. Unit: bit/s

AvgResponseTime.description_en: The average response time. Unit: milliseconds
AvgResponseTime.description_zh: 平均响应时间，单位：毫秒

BytesProportion.description_en: The proportion of traffic from the region. For example, a value of 90 indicates that 90% of the traffic is from the region
BytesProportion.description_zh: 总流量占比，例如返回90即为90%

Proportion.description_en: The proportion of visits from the region. For example, a value of 90 indicates that 90% of the visits are from the region
Proportion.description_zh: 访问占比数据，例如返回90即为90%

Qps.description_en: The number of queries per second

ReqErrRate.description_en: The request error rate. A value of 90 indicates that 90% of the requests encountered errors
ReqErrRate.description_zh: 请求错误率，例如返回90即为90%
